test_title: PYST 31: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The company specialises at / designing, crafting and manufacturing / exquisite, high-quality furniture / of exceptional craftsmanship.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the preposition "at" after the verb "specialises".
 
• The correct preposition to be used with "specialises" is "in".
 
• The correct phrase should be "The company specialises in" to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The company specialises in designing, crafting and manufacturing exquisite, high-quality furniture of exceptional craftsmanship."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"designing, crafting and manufacturing"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"exquisite, high-quality furniture"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **"of exceptional craftsmanship"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
